ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Product UI/UX Designer to shape the player-facing experience of a B2C casino and sportsbook across desktop and mobile web. This is a long-term product design role—not front-end development, slot-game illustration, or banner-only production.

CREATIVITY IS THE CORE OF THIS ROLE

We need someone who can originate distinctive visual concepts, not simply rearrange templates. You should be able to take a product brief, explore multiple directions, explain your decisions, and turn the strongest idea into a cohesive, intuitive interface.

Our design direction is clean, premium, familiar, and comfortable to use. We value thoughtful typography, spacing, hierarchy, reusable components, subtle motion, and strong attention to detail. The product includes Korean-language layouts, but Korean fluency is not required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Propose original visual directions and interaction ideas that give the product a recognizable identity.

• Design responsive homepages, casino lobbies, game cards, search, filters, promotions, and navigation.

• Design sportsbook event lists, odds displays, markets, live states, and bet-slip interactions.

• Improve sign-up, account, wallet, transaction history, notifications, messages, and promotion screens.

• Turn user flows into polished screens, interactive prototypes, and reusable Figma components.

• Define desktop/mobile behavior and hover, focus, selected, disabled, loading, empty, and error states.

• Collaborate with the product owner and developers on implementation details and visual QA.

• Occasionally support promotional banners and lightweight UI motion; product UI remains the primary focus.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Strong creative judgment and a portfolio showing original concepts, exploration, and polished execution.

• 2+ years of hands-on web or product UI/UX design experience.

• At least one relevant casino OR sportsbook website project; experience in both is a plus.

• Strong Figma skills: Auto Layout, components, variants, variables/styles, prototypes, and organized developer handoff.

• Solid responsive design, typography, information hierarchy, and interaction design skills.

• Working English for written communication and design discussions.

• Ability to explain exactly what you personally owned and why you made key design decisions.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Korean or other Asian-market consumer interfaces.

• Design systems for content-rich products.

• Micro-interaction prototypes, subtle motion, or promotional banner design.

• Basic understanding of HTML/CSS constraints; coding is not required.

ENGAGEMENT

• Long-term, fully remote contract with full-time-equivalent availability.

• Monthly compensation: USD 1,500–2,000, depending on portfolio quality and relevant experience.

• Candidates worldwide are welcome; working-hour overlap can be discussed.

• Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a small paid trial before the long-term engagement.

HOW TO APPLY

Share 1–3 relevant projects and briefly explain:

1. Which screens, components, and design decisions you personally owned.

2. One original idea you introduced, the alternatives you explored, and why you chose the final direction.

3. Your experience with casino lobbies, sportsbook odds/markets, bet slips, wallets, or other relevant flows.

4. Your availability and expected monthly compensation.

Desktop/mobile examples and an NDA-safe Figma walkthrough are welcome. AI-assisted work is acceptable, but you must demonstrate your own design decisions and editable, production-ready work. Generic templates, banner-only portfolios, and AI-generated screenshots alone are not sufficient.

We are building AirOps to become the best place for businesses to experiment, deploy and scale LLM powered workflows and solutions with little to no code. We have raised $7 million led by Wing VC with participation from Founder Collective, XFund, Village Global, Apollo Projects and Lachy Groom. About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious ux designer that has a track record of delivering delightful experiences in semi-technical or no/low-code tools. You would be owning many of the core interaction challenges in our builder, AirOps Studio including helping users design great prompts, connect third party tools, construct powerful AI assistants and more. Designer

Design Design the Future of Commerce

Shopify’s mission is to make commerce better for everyone. We wake up every day focused on ways to inspire, enable, and support entrepreneurs. We are transforming how millions of unique brands start, run, and grow their businesses - and we are just getting started.

Design has always been essential to this mission. It is our DNA—defining how we build products, solve problems, grow the company, empower our merchants, and engage their buyers.

Who we’re looking for

We are always looking for tasteful designers who move fast, sweat details, are technically fluent, and love to tinker. Entrepreneurial energy drives our mission and our internal culture. We want designers that are prolific and prefer less process and more freedom to build. We want designers that break boundaries between product and brand, art and technology, imagery and words. We are a fully remote company so we need people that speak up, share openly, and are proactive in creating connections. Most importantly we want people that are courageous and curious - in their work, in their giving and sharing feedback, and in their appetite to embrace the new, the difficult and the unknown.

AI? Ok, let’s talk about it.

Yes, AI is changing everything. And yes, we’re all in.

We are embracing AI in our tools, workflows and philosophies because we believe technology will always create opportunities for those sufficiently courageous to claim it. We want people committed to the tools of tomorrow, because true innovation happens when craft excellence meets technological audacity. We are confident that in a world where AI can help produce almost anything, designers that can master and wield these tools with incredible taste and judgement are even more necessary than ever.

Want to hear more about Shopify and AI? Get it straight from the top.

This is where you come in

Here’s what we expect from designers at Shopify:

You are an opinionated tastemaker

You are a connoisseur of software design and digital culture and can confidently push its boundaries.

You are a master of your craft

You wield rock-solid design fundamentals and have an obsession for detail and a deep appreciation for craft.

You’re a hands-on builder, coach and student

You revel in making things, trying things, sharing things and taking ownership of your own development.

You are driven

You thrive in and help create an uptempo environment, generating a lot of ideas, showing your work often, shipping fast, and always pushing to get your project to the next step. You raise the energy on teams around you, and elevate your teammates by showing them what is possible.

You embrace new tools

You grab hold of every new tool as soon as you can, and fearlessly push the edges of what is possible.

You are technically fluent

You’re comfortable working close to the code, proactively collaborate with engineers, and are comfortable prototyping your work directly.

Most importantly, you care

Good design work comes from craft excellence, and we certainly expect that of you. But great design work comes from care. You care deeply about our mission, our merchants, and the world we want to serve. A spirit of care is what comes through is our unreasonable attention to every detail, every word, every millisecond of performance, every support interaction. It is care that animates our brand. If care and working on something meaningful is what drives you to strive and wield your skills and tools expertly…then Shopify might be for you.

About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

If you believe entrepreneurship can change lives, and you want your work to fuel that change, let us know.

Join IMP, a fast-growing B2B SaaS company focused on helping Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) take control of their finances. As a Product Designer, you'll work closely with product squads, leading the design process from concept generation to usability testing and iteration. You'll have high autonomy and the opportunity to shape the design of established and next-generation products.

Job Title:

Product Designer - B2B SaaS

Salary:

£50,000 - £60,000

About IMP

At IMP we help Multi-Academy Trusts (MATs) take control of their finances. Our MAT-first software is built by people who know the sector inside out. Former trust professionals, finance experts and product specialists are all part of our team. More than half of all MATs in the UK already use IMP to plan with confidence, simplify complex processes and make smarter decisions.

We’re proud to be independent, founder-led and growing fast. Alongside our award-winning products, we’ve built a culture we’re equally proud of. We are ranked as one of the UK’s Top 25 Great Places to Work for mid-sized companies. Respect, collaboration and personal growth sit at the heart of how we work. You’ll find flexibility, support and opportunities to develop here, alongside regular team socials and funded CPD.

The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to support our product squads and help grow our design operations.

You’ll be the only designer in the squads you support, taking prioritised requirements through divergent concepts, testing, iteration and convergence to something shipped and working in front of real finance teams - and you’ll stay with it through build. You’ll set the pace, make the calls, and bring engineering and product with you.

You will be one of two designers at IMP, working directly with our Head of Product Design. That is a deliberately small function: high autonomy, a short line to every decision, and nothing between you and the work. You will not be managing anyone.

Why this role is unusual

IMP is entering one of the most ambitious periods of product work in its history - the kind that comes round once in a company’s life, and rarely at one small enough that a single designer can leave fingerprints all over it.

To set us up for this transition, we’re re-writing our design playbook and using it to influence the design of our established and next-generation greenfield products. It’s the design platform we always dreamed about building: prioritising human creativity, exploiting AI tooling to help with drudgery and knowledge plumbing, and supercharging our output quality so we punch above our weight. You’ll be helping to shape all this. A couple of notable areas we’ve been developing recently:

•

IMPDesign.one

- our unified design system, spanning every product in the suite, generated and maintained by AI, human in the loop at every critical point.

•

IMPDesign.skills - A suite of AI-powered design skills built to remove the least interesting parts of the job - while leaving the thinking, the judgement and the craft entirely ours.

•

IMPInsight - A new insight platform for managing user feedback, allowing us to better understand our users’ needs, better test our assumptions and spend more time interpreting and using evidence in our craft.

That combination is rare: design work that reshapes software already critically relied on by real finance teams, building next-gen design operations at the forefront of the industry and working on greenfield concepts that grow our product suite.

And we strongly believe we’ve found the right balance between human creativity and AI tooling support – so if you’ve been using or experimenting with generative AI in your own practice and want somewhere that will fund it, take it seriously and let you push it further, this is unusually good ground.

What you'll own

No surprises here, but just to be explicit: your squads’ Product Owners run the discovery research that decides which user needs we address and in what order. From the point those prioritised requirements land, the design is yours:

•

Concept generation. Diverge first. Turn requirements into multiple concept variants that open the problem up and get teams thinking.

•

Usability testing. Test concepts with real users and our in-house domain experts - colleagues who have run MAT finance first-hand.

•

Collecting feedback + iterating. Fold the feedback back in, and support the squad in landing on a final solution everyone understands and you can defend.

•

Stay with it through build. Support the team through story breakdown and technical refinement, so what ships is what was agreed.

But you won’t be on your own:

•

Domain experts on-hand: You’ll be supported by stupendously knowledgeable product owners and product specialists helping you get the domain knowledge nailed.

•

Peer review, No donuts - You’ll be able to bounce ideas off and do peer reviews with the head of design (who designs our other products). And you’ll be working in a team of people who literally embody our company principle of “Don’t be a donut” who will treat you with respect and dignity and expect the same in return.

•

Regular planning, coaching and mentoring – You’ll be expected to manage your own work, but we have two dedicated sessions every week: one at the beginning to help plan your week, and one at the end to focus on you, your wellbeing and helping with any coaching and mentoring you’d like support with.

What we need from you

Essential

•

You've been the design lead on a squad or team - the only designer in the room, making the call. You can walk us through a real piece of work from requirement to shipped software and show us your decisions along the way.

•

You're a self-starter. Remote, embedded, sole designer: nobody is going to sequence your week for you.

•

You use generative AI in your design practice, or you've been actively exploring it. We don’t need you to be an expert - we need real curiosity and evidence you have tried things. You aren’t afraid to dabble in the Terminal. You’re experimental. Come ready to show us what you have built, broken or learned.

•

You design well for complex, data-dense products, and you write clearly enough that a remote team can follow your reasoning without a meeting.

•

A portfolio that shows your thinking and your process, not just the final screens.

Nice to have

•

Experience with accounting, finance or budgeting software.

•

B2B SaaS experience, particularly where users are professionals doing serious work under time pressure.

•

Experience designing interfaces on top of AI output - review states, confidence, correction, human-in-the-loop.

•

Experience designing across a multi-product platform or suite, rather than a single application.

•

Public-sector, education or otherwise regulated-domain experience.

Benefits:

•

27 days of holiday per year plus bank holidays (with a buy option up to an additional 5 days)

•

Enhance Maternity and Paternity leave

•

AXA Health insurance including dental, optical and mental health

•

Broadband allowance

•

Home office stipend

•

Life assurance (4 x basic salary)

•

Encouraged and funded CPD

jd.80dbd1911cf44991:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control .

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience .

Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

The Opportunity at Altana

Altana's mission is to fix globalization. We are building a network that brings together public and private sector entities, across myriad workflows from customs and transaction processing, to macro policy analysis, to supply chain resilience. As Head of Design you will shape the product vision of Altana and bring it to life. You will create a consistent, agent-first design system for handling a wide array of information-dense, complex workflows across governments, logistics providers, importers, and their suppliers across a range of use cases.

And you need to lean into the evolving role of product design in an AI-native software development lifecycle. Traditional design organizations are not set up for this world. They scale linearly with headcount, ship Figma files to engineers as the unit of work, treat the design system as a component library, and assume the user is a single human clicking through a single product. That model is already breaking. Product managers can prototype in working code. Engineers can generate full interfaces from a prompt. Customers increasingly interact with the product through an agent that reasons, summarizes, and acts on their behalf. The center of gravity for how experiences get made is shifting — and the design organizations that thrive next will not be the ones that draw the most screens. Our head of design is expected to help us create this new world and evolve traditional SDLC’s to tighten the feedback loop, and produce more output faster together in a native AI loop.

We are looking for a Head of Design to build Altana's design organization for that world from the ground up: an agent-first design team whose primary deliverable is not a static mockup but a living design system — a structured, semantic, machine-readable language of patterns, components, primitives, and interaction grammars that PMs, engineers, and AI agents can compose against to ship coherent, on-brand, high-quality experiences without a designer in the critical path of every screen. You will redefine what it means to design an in-product experience when the user on the other side is sometimes a customs broker, sometimes a Fortune 500 trade compliance team, sometimes a sovereign government analyst, and increasingly, sometimes an AI agent acting on their behalf. You will treat AI not as a feature you bolt onto the UI but as a native participant in every workflow — with its own surfaces, affordances, failure modes, and trust signals — and you will build the design language that makes human-and-agent collaboration feel obvious instead of awkward.

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer .

Job Description

Your mission

You’ll explore how to harness the potential of AI to scale your impact as a designer. You’ll quickly test and iterate on your ideas with a high degree of freedom and flexibility, learning as part of your day-to-day work as the technology evolves.

You’ll shape the core Wise Assistant experience for Support and beyond. You’ll design the system that guides our customers through every part of the Wise product, giving them quick and reliable help exactly when they need it. Together with your technical partners, you’ll architect and design agents, own prompts, and define how context and knowledge are used to resolve real customer problems.

This role will sit within the Content Design Guild as part of our Design team, as the disciplines share a common skill set and design process.

How you’ll contribute:

• Together with a team of engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you’ll design the systems that enable Wise to deliver conversational AI experiences that help customers at the exact moment they need support.

• You’ll collaborate with partners across engineering, data science, product, and design to set the vision and strategy, and coach teams to deliver it.

• You’ll shape agent behaviour, define how components of the system interact, and own prompts, reasoning, and context.

• You’ll be influential within your product area, identifying and prioritising system needs and delivering the most impactful projects across multiple teams.

• Using your expertise, you’ll raise design maturity and deepen the Support squad’s understanding of context engineering.

• As part of the Content Design Guild, you’ll regularly collaborate with Wise’s wider content community. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to partner with other Model and Content Designers to evolve how we approach working with AI as designers.

This role will give you the opportunity to:

• Own the squad’s automation strategy end to end and steer its direction.

• Champion quality for our customers—you’ll define what good looks like within the squad and demonstrate it through everything you ship.

• Be part of a positive change in the world. We’re fixing a broken system and putting people and businesses in control of their money.

About you:

• You’re an accomplished and experienced Model Designer, or a systems-focused Content Designer who has already made this transition in your day-to-day work. You bring extensive experience in designing large, complex automation systems that deliver exceptional experiences to customers.

• You have an in-depth understanding of AI and strong perspectives on how its underpinning systems should be shaped, both within user-facing products and as part of the design process.

• You’ve designed systems that generate content and experiences to guide customers, including prompts, guardrails, knowledge architecture, and agents.

• You love learning new things, nerding out on technical details, and applying what you learn to solve complex problems.

• You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and collaborating successfully in this kind of environment. You learn quickly and put what you learn into practice.

• You have an eye for quality and know where to focus to improve it.

• You’re influential and inspiring, and you work well with others in a culture that values autonomy and empowerment. You champion the role of model design and content design in automation-based projects and enjoy coaching designers who are new to these kinds of products.

• You’re highly empathetic, both towards customers and the people you work with.

Heads up: this probably isn’t for you if:

You haven’t previously worked hands-on with a large-scale automated system. This role requires a high level of technical expertise and the ability to partner as an equal with data scientists and engineers when designing large, complex AI systems. You should already have a strong working knowledge of common prompt-engineering techniques and frameworks, context engineering, and agentic design.

Your experience is mostly in marketing content, advertising, copywriting, journalism, or social media, and you have no hands-on experience in model design, content design, or UX.

You’re not comfortable navigating complexity or working in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Our flexible work philosophy

Flexibility at Squarespace isn’t new and all roles at Squarespace are flexible in one way or another. Before the pandemic, Squarespace embraced flexible work - 13% of our employees were fully remote, while most in-office employees had flexible schedules.

As we look to the future of work, we are increasing our existing flexibility. We believe that flexibility increases productivity and satisfaction, decreases our carbon footprint related to commuting, and enables us to attract and retain a more diverse and inclusive workforce.

Squarespace’s Flexible Work Policy outlines two distinct work classifications - Officespace and Homespace - designed to help foster an inclusive and collaborative environment. In the same way that there isn’t a one size fits all solution for our customers, there isn’t a one size fits all approach that will work for every individual and every role. So we have empowered individuals, their managers, and department leaders to determine the appropriate approach to flexible work for them. The type of flexibility needed will vary based on the role - with consideration for whether the role needs to have face to face collaboration and interaction, and the ability for that role to be done remotely vs. in the office.

1. Officespace - employees who spend at least some of their week working from a Squarespace office location. Each Officespace employee’s work schedule is agreed upon between them and their manager and approved by their department head, with some being fully in-office and some having flexible schedules. Depending on their role and how often they are in the office, some Officespace employees will have assigned desks while others will participate in hoteling of desk space.

2. Homespace - employees who spend all or the majority of their time working remotely and do not have a desk in a Squarespace office. Fully remote positions are currently available for designated roles at department discretion.

We also embrace the benefits of face to face interaction and collaboration, so curating an enticing office experience remains part of our Squarespace approach. Our office is so much more than a place people go to work. Each of our offices has been built to inspire creativity and foster community. It’s more than a workplace. We invite all who enter to find a space that feels their own. It’s a collective. It’s our space.

Whether you have a Officespace or Homespace workstyle, we aspire to foster collaboration and connection between everyone at Squarespace.

That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team & Role:

At ServiceNow, we embrace representation in and from all professional and personal backgrounds and cultures. This diversity inspires passion and creativity among our teams and propels innovation in our products. This role is part of our Product Design team that uses their superpower of empathizing, understanding, and applying our users’ and customers’ needs, with the mission to created product experiences they love. Our designers come from a diverse set of skills and background - design systems, visual, interaction, content, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has a very intentional seat at the table, so our team collaborates closely with both engineering and product management from the get-go.

Learn more about our team here: https://www.linkedin.com/company/servicenow/life/userexperience/

This is not a standard product design role. Designing for content at this scale requires fluency in large-scale content architecture, fragmented content libraries, structured content systems, cross-property consolidation, and AI-mediated retrieval design. This requires a practitioner who specializes in owning the customer's experience of finding, navigating, and using content across dozens of sources, teams, and systems.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

•
8+ years in digital product design with strong expertise in both B2B SaaS and B2C design

•
Proven ability to design complex information architectures and UX systems serving diverse audiences (learners, admins, community members)

•
Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design strategy from narrative development through high-fidelity execution

•
Demonstrated design leadership leading teams through rapid iteration, managing feedback loops, and maintaining quality amid parallel workstreams

•
Ability to articulate UX architecture frameworks that translate platform conventions into cohesive adjacent web experiences

•
Strategic communicator who presents design thinking to senior stakeholders, refines scope through clarifying questions, and advocates for user-centered approaches

•
Ability to synthesize research insights and user feedback into actionable design direction and vision refinements

•
Mastery of Figma and collaborative design workflows at scale; experience navigating matrixed organizations with competing priorities

•
Comfortable with evolving priorities, dual-track workstreams, and the ambiguity inherent in transformational product initiatives

•
Preferred: experience with learning platforms, AI-native design patterns, multi-property experience consolidation, or brand-driven design systems

Basic Qualifications:

•
BA/BS degree or higher in Design, Design Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent combination of education and experience in other related fields

•
Experience participating in the complete product development lifecycle of web and/or software applications

•
Experience in user experience design or industry experience (corporate, software, web or agency)

Company Description

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. We deliver award-winning enterprise software solutions through the use of embedded digital innovation and a single cloud-based platform to help businesses be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™.

At IFS, we're flexible, we're innovative, and we're focused not only on how we can engage with our customers, but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society's greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and accept that there are so many different perspectives in this world. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We're looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs.

If you want to change the status quo, we'll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

Job Description

You'll be designing for people whose work actually matters: maintenance engineers, field service technicians, operations planners working in environments where the software either helps or gets in the way. The stakes are real and the problems are hard, which is exactly what makes this role interesting.

At IFS, product design means owning the full problem, not just the screens. You'll work in a cross-functional squad alongside engineers and product managers, with the scope and support to do the work properly. From problem framing through to something shipped and measured.

But the deeper question is harder than that. The industries IFS serves (field service, asset management, manufacturing, supply chain) are changing faster than the software that runs them. By 2030, we're not confident the interface paradigms we rely on today will still be the right ones. AI, ambient computing, voice, autonomous systems: any of these could fundamentally change how an operations planner or a field engineer interacts with software, or whether they interact with it at all.

That's not a problem we've solved. It's the problem you'd be working on.

What you'll do

Product Design

•
Own design for defined feature areas end-to-end — from problem framing through to production-ready Figma files, with a clear rationale for every decision

•
Work in a cross-functional squad with engineers and PMs, making real decisions rather than executing on someone else's brief

•
Present design thinking to stakeholders with confidence — handling pushback with evidence, not just conviction

Discovery & Research

•
Plan and run user interviews, JTBD analysis, and journey mapping independently — turning findings into clear design direction, not just a readout

•
Track quantitative signals alongside qualitative insight, and use both to drive iteration

AI & Emerging Technology

•
Design AI-driven features with a clear understanding of where AI helps and where it introduces risk — prompts, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop moments included

•
Bring a genuine perspective on how the interfaces we're building today might become obsolete — and what should replace them

Design Systems & Quality

•
Contribute to the IFS design system by proposing reusable components and patterns rather than designing one-offs

•
Apply WCAG 2.1+ accessibility standards from the start, and design for edge cases, error states, and real-world data — not just the happy path

You'll know it's working when your work ships, holds up in the field, and raises the bar for the next thing. Concretely: task success rates improve, UX-related support tickets drop, and the squad reaches for your work as a reference rather than a starting point.

Qualifications

You may be a good fit if you:

•
You have at least eight years of end-to-end product design experience — from discovery through to shipped product — and you can point to work that reflects real ownership, not just execution

•
You're comfortable running your own research: planning the study, conducting interviews, synthesising findings, and turning them into a clear design direction

•
You know how to work in a cross-functional squad — making real decisions alongside engineers and PMs, not waiting to be handed a brief

•
You know Figma well and have the visual craft to back your thinking up

•
You treat accessibility as a design constraint from the start, not a checklist at the end

•
You've thought seriously about what AI means for the interfaces you build — not just as a feature to add, but as something that changes the fundamental design problem

•
You measure your work — task success rates, support ticket volume, adoption — and use those signals to drive the next iteration

Strong candidates may also have:

•
Experience shipping AI-driven features — prompts, fallbacks, human-in-the-loop moments — not just awareness of the concepts

•
Familiarity with design tokens, contribution models, and what it means to design for a system rather than a screen

•
Some exposure to quantitative signals: task success rates, funnel data, or A/B results — and a habit of using them

Additional Information

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

At Code and Theory, Designers shape identity systems, campaigns, and digital product experiences that help brands feel distinct and relevant. We’re looking for a Senior Designer with strong visual instincts, sharp craft, and most importantly, deep AI fluency and prototyping momentum: someone who uses AI to think faster, make more, and close the gap between concept and build.

This role is for someone who cares deeply about typography, layout, interaction, motion, and the details that make work feel clear, expressive, and culturally aware. You’re excited to build brands that scale from foundational identity systems to campaign concepts and into real, shippable product experiences and you’re genuinely obsessed with emerging AI tools, building custom workflows, and using them to expand exploration, speed iteration, and raise the fidelity of what you hand to engineering.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design across brand identity systems, campaigns, and digital product experiences (web, mobile, platforms)

• Create scalable visual languages and design systems that work across marketing and product environments

• Translate strategy into clear concepts, flows, UI frameworks, and high-craft executions

• Prototype early and often from interaction/motion studies to clickable and high-fidelity prototypes that reduce ambiguity and accelerate delivery

• Use AI as a core design tool, not an add-on: build and refine workflows for ideation, iteration, production support, and rapid prototyping

• Partner with strategists, writers, producers, and engineers to bring work to life end-to-end, with an emphasis on feasibility and build-ready detail

• Present work clearly, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and contribute to client conversations when needed

• Balance conceptual exploration with strong day-to-day design production across multiple workstreams

• Deliver high-fidelity concepts that developers can build from ensuring what ships looks and behaves like what was intended (handoff, QA, iteration)

• Manage workload and project timelines to keep design work prioritized, scoped appropriately, and delivered on schedule

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• High AI fluency and curiosity: you’re not just familiar with tools you’re actively experimenting, developing opinions, and evolving your workflow

• The ability to turn ideas into tangible, testable experiences quickly, using prototypes to drive alignment and decisions

• Strong communication skills, collaborative mindset, and ability to own pieces of work independently

• A portfolio showing strong craft across identity, campaign, and product/UI work (systems + execution)

• Strong typography, composition, interaction sensibility, and systems thinking with high attention to detail

• Experience contributing to design systems and applying them across both marketing and product surfaces

• Comfort collaborating closely with engineers (handoff, feasibility, QA) and working in iterative build cycles

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $90,000 – $115,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

Stability AI is the leader in purpose-built AI products for professional creatives across music, gaming, and entertainment.

Stability AI sparked the generative AI revolution when it announced the release of Stable Diffusion in August 2022, putting generative technology in the hands of millions of creators globally and cementing its position as a leader in the field. Stable Diffusion models have since been downloaded more than 350 million times, serving as the technical foundation for an entire ecosystem of work.

We build for creatives first. Our work expands beyond the models themselves into products and solutions designed for specific production workflows. This artist-centric approach is why Electronic Arts, Universal Music Group, Warner Music Group, WPP, and others have chosen us as their strategic partner.

Stability AI is recognized among Fortune's 50 AI Innovators and TIME's Most Influential Companies, with Stable Audio named to TIME's Best Inventions list. In June 2024, Stability AI entered a new phase of growth with a leadership team including CEO Prem Akkaraju, Executive Chairman Sean Parker, and Board Member James Cameron, alongside board members Dana Settle and Thomas Laffont.

The company is backed by world-class investors including interactive entertainment innovator Electronic Arts; global leaders in music entertainment Sony Music Group, Universal Music Group, and Warner Music Group; investment firms Greycroft, Coatue, WPP, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sound Ventures, AMD Ventures, and Mantis Capital; and individual investors Sean Parker, Eric Schmidt, and James Cameron.

You can learn more at stability.ai .

Stability AI is unlocking the power of open-source generative AI to expand human creativity. We build world-class models that are accessible, adaptable, and designed to empower creators, developers, and enterprises everywhere.

About us:

BetterMe — an all-in-one well-being ecosystem empowering millions to become better — physically, mentally, and emotionally. We build what makes people better and keep challenging ourselves to inspire others.

As a Product Designer at BetterMe, you will create visually engaging B2C experiences that combine strong graphic design with product thinking. You will work on funnels, landing pages, and other user journeys, exploring creative concepts and using AI tools to turn product and marketing ideas into polished designs that drive user engagement and business results.

Your impact:

• Design and improve B2C user experiences, quizzes, funnels, landing pages, and other product flows.

• Create visually strong concepts that communicate the right message and support product and marketing goals.

• Explore multiple design directions and propose creative solutions rather than stopping at the first idea.

• Work closely with Product, Development, QA, and other designers to bring ideas from concept to production.

• Collaborate with product teams on experiments, iterations, and improvements based on business priorities.

• Use AI tools in your daily design workflow, including image generation and tools such as Claude.

• Create and adapt visual assets while keeping them relevant to the product, audience, and context.

• Prepare clear design specifications and ensure high-quality implementation together with developers.

• Contribute ideas and hypotheses based on your understanding of users, the product, and business goals.

About you:

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual and graphic design skills — this is one of the key things we’ll be looking at.

• Experience designing B2C digital products, marketing-driven experiences, quizzes, funnels, landing pages, or similar user journeys.

• Experience with A/B testing and designing for experimentation.

• Strong command of typography, composition, imagery, and visual storytelling.

• Product mindset: you understand that design is not only about aesthetics, but also about user behavior, conversion, and business outcomes.

• Ability to work quickly, iterate, and adapt when product or business priorities change.

• Proactive and independent approach: you can work with an open-ended task, explore alternatives, and make decisions without requiring detailed instructions at every step.

• Ability to present and explain your design decisions and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Experience using AI tools for design and image generation, or strong motivation to actively incorporate them into your workflow.

• Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to continuously learn and experiment.

Will be a plus:

• Hands-on experience designing quizzes or conversion-focused funnels.

• Previous experience in a creative/digital agency, especially working on campaigns, promotional websites, social media creatives, or other visually driven projects.

• Experience working in a fast-paced B2C product company.

• Experience using AI not only for content and image generation, but also for improving or automating parts of your design workflow.

What you get at BetterMe:

A mission that matters. Every product, design, and idea we create helps millions of people become healthier and more confident.
Trust without micromanagement. You’ll have the autonomy to manage your time, make decisions, and take ownership of your work. We value outcomes, not hours online.
Room to grow. 90% of our leads have grown within the company. You’ll have space to take initiative, expand your responsibilities, and develop your career
Wellness in practice.
Offline: workouts with professional trainers in our corporate gym, massage, corporate lunches, sports activities, and team events.
Online: regular online workouts, partner discounts, and free access to BetterMe products.
Medical insurance and access to a corporate doctor.
Vacation and work-life balance. 20 paid vacation days, paid sick leave, and additional days off around public holidays.
Open communication. Transparency between teams, direct feedback, and support for new ideas are part of how we work.
Support for sports activities. We cover participation fees for sporting events and encourage our team to take part together.
Modern equipment. We provide up-to-date hardware and everything you need to work effectively.
Legal and financial support. Our experienced legal and finance teams are available to help with work-related documentation and consultations.

Find more about us on social media platforms: Instagram , LinkedIn .

Mission

To advance the adoption of the Walrus Protocol – a Verifiable Data Platform for AI Builders

Vision

To create a foundation for AI builders to store and manage their data, making that data persistent, portable, and under their control across apps, providers, and agents.

Walrus Foundation is looking for a Staff Product Designer to define and own the product experience for Walrus.

Walrus is infrastructure for developers, and designing infrastructure products requires a particular kind of product thinking. Users need to navigate technical concepts, understand system state, work with large amounts of information, configure resources, diagnose problems, and take actions that can have real consequences for their data, storage, or spend.

You’ll partner closely with product and engineering from the earliest stages of discovery through implementation. You won’t receive finished requirements and turn them into screens. You’ll help determine which problems matter, investigate how developers actually work, challenge assumptions, prototype and test potential solutions, and ultimately define how developers experience Walrus.

As a Staff designer, you’ll also establish the systems and standards that allow the product to scale. You’ll think beyond individual features to create consistent interaction patterns, reusable components, and product principles that make the entire Walrus experience more coherent over time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

– Own the Walrus product experience. Define and evolve the end-to-end developer experience across Walrus’s product surfaces and key workflows.

– Lead discovery with product and engineering. Help frame problems before the team jumps to solutions, identify unanswered questions, and determine what evidence we need before committing to build.

– Bring developers directly into the design process. Conduct lightweight developer interviews and usability tests, put prototypes in front of real users, and synthesize findings into decisions the team can act on.

– Design complex technical workflows. Create flows, wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready designs for experiences involving dense data, system state, configuration, resource management, and high-consequence actions.

– Influence product direction. Bring a strong point of view on what Walrus should build—not just how features should look—and constructively challenge product and engineering assumptions when needed.

– Build Walrus’s design system. Establish and maintain shared components, interaction patterns, and product principles that create consistency and allow the product surface to grow without fragmenting.

– Benchmark the market. Regularly tear down comparable developer and infrastructure products to understand established patterns, identify opportunities, and avoid reinventing solved problems.

– Stay close through implementation. Partner with engineering throughout development, review what ships against the intended experience, catch problems early, and incorporate requirements and feedback from partners such as Legal.

– Raise the design bar. Establish what excellent developer-product design looks like for Walrus and help create the practices that maintain that standard as the organization grows.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

– 8-10 years of product design experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex technical products.

– A portfolio demonstrating ownership of shipped developer tools, cloud/infrastructure products, consoles, dashboards, or similarly complex technical products.

– Demonstrated ability to simplify technically sophisticated workflows without removing the control or information expert users need.

– Strong interaction-design skills across data-heavy interfaces, tables, configuration, complex states, progressive disclosure, permissions, errors, and high-consequence actions.

– Experience independently identifying and framing product problems rather than primarily executing against predefined requirements.

– A track record of influencing product strategy and roadmap decisions through design.

– Strong qualitative research instincts and experience incorporating lightweight user research and usability testing into day-to-day product work.

– Experience creating or significantly evolving design systems and reusable interaction patterns.

– Strong partnership with engineering and a willingness to remain involved through implementation and design QA.

– Excellent communication skills and the confidence to disagree constructively with senior product and engineering partners.

– Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving technical environment.

Finom’s platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We’re actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

• Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to effectively scope, prioritize, and define project outcomes.

• Create essential design artifacts including user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes.

• Contribute actively to our design system and maintain consistency and scalability across the entire user interface.

• Participate robustly in usability testing, user feedback loops, and data-driven experimentation.

• Support high-priority initiatives such as modular pricing, onboarding UX transformation, and the development of AI Copilot features.

Who You Are

• 4+ years of experience in product design , ideally gained within fast-paced fintech or SaaS environments.

• A strong portfolio that clearly demonstrates user-centered thinking and polished execution across various projects.

• Confidence working in cross-functional squads with engineers, analysts, and product managers.

• The ability to rationalize your design decisions rigorously using data, research insights, and direct customer feedback.

• A strong foundation of curiosity, pragmatism, and a consistently high bar for design quality and craft.

Nice to Have

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Equal Opportunity Statement

Summary of the Role:

As a Product Designer at Maze, you’ll define what product design looks like for AI agents in cybersecurity — a problem space where the design patterns don’t exist yet. This is an early-hire role at a well-funded Series A startup building at the intersection of generative AI and security, and you’ll own the product surface end-to-end while working directly with our Head of Product, engineering, and founders.

The product challenge is genuinely new. Our AI agents investigate vulnerabilities autonomously, surface findings with real context, and collaborate with security teams to cut through noise. Your job is to design how humans and agents work together — how trust gets built, how decisions get communicated, how complex security workflows become understandable. There’s no playbook for this. You’ll create one.

This role suits someone who operates closer to a product director than a screen-shipper — driving direction, influencing strategy, and making business-impact calls, alongside the visual craft to deliver them. You’ll be using AI tools daily to move faster, but your craft is the floor: every design choice should hold up on its own merits, independent of how it was generated. Success looks like a design system shipped and adopted across the product, and concrete product outcomes — feature adoption, POC-to-customer conversion, and customer satisfaction with the experiences you ship.

Your Contribution:

•

Define AI-Agent UX Patterns: Design how security teams collaborate with autonomous AI agents — how investigations get presented, how trust is established, how humans steer the agent without slowing it down. You’re inventing patterns, not applying existing ones.

•

Drive Product Direction, Not Just Design: Operate as a product-led designer — shaping roadmap, challenging requirements, influencing leadership with research and business reasoning. The bar is “what should we build, and why” alongside “how should it look.”

•

Own the Product Surface End-to-End: Take features from problem framing through shipped product, working in tight partnership with PMs and engineers — including backend. Run discovery, prototype rapidly, validate with customers, and stay close to implementation. No throwing designs over the wall, no shipping around the engineering team.

•

Build the Design System: Create and scale a component-based design system that becomes the foundation for everything we ship. Establish patterns for AI-human collaboration that the team can build on as we grow.

•

Pioneer AI-Assisted Design Workflows: Use AI tools to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and exploration — and develop the methodologies the rest of the team will adopt. Your daily workflow is itself a contribution.

•

Translate Research Into Design: Run customer research, talk to security teams directly, and turn what you learn into shipped product. Use AI-assisted analysis to move from insight to prototype in days, not weeks.

•

Set the Quality Bar: Establish what “good” looks like for product design at Maze across craft, consistency, and customer impact — as the foundation for a design team that scales behind you.

What You Need to Be Successful:

•

Visual Craft for Data-Dense UI: A portfolio that holds up to detailed scrutiny — strong colour theory, deliberate visual hierarchy, considered information architecture for complex workflows. This is the bar, not a nice-to-have. Your interview will dig into specific design choices and why you made them.

•

Product Design Track Record: 4-7 years of professional product design experience, with shipped work in B2B SaaS. We’re flexible on years; demonstrated craft and clear ownership matter more than time served.

•

Data-Heavy B2B Interfaces: Direct experience designing for complex workflows, dense data, and technical audiences. Dashboards, investigation tools, developer products, security platforms — the kind of UI where information density and decision support actually matter.

•

AI as Tool, Not Crutch: You use AI tools (Figma AI, Cursor, v0, Midjourney, ChatGPT/Claude, etc.) as part of your daily workflow and can speak credibly to what they’re good for and where they break down. Critically, every design choice you ship should hold up on its own — AI accelerates your work, it doesn’t substitute for foundational craft.

•

Product-Strategic Thinking: Track record of driving product direction, not just executing on briefs. You’ve influenced what to build with research, framed problems for leadership, and made business-impact calls — ideally in environments where you operated without a dedicated PM.

•

Deep Engineering Collaboration: Demonstrable history of shipping work in tight partnership with engineers — including backend. Pairing on implementation, working in design tokens, understanding the systems your designs land in, building consensus rather than shipping around resistance.

•

Design Systems Experience: Background building or meaningfully contributing to a design system in a production product. You think in components, tokens, and patterns, not one-off screens.

•

Customer-Led Approach: Comfortable running discovery directly with users, synthesising what you hear, and using that to make calls about what to build. You don’t wait for research to be handed to you.

•

Nice to haves:

•

Experience designing for cybersecurity, developer tools, or other technical product domains

•

Background designing agentic or AI-native product experiences (not just AI features bolted onto existing products)

•

Early-stage startup experience where you’ve operated without a manager or established design function

Why Join Us:

•

Define a New Design Space: AI agents in security is a genuinely new problem. The interaction patterns, trust models, and workflows don’t exist yet — you’ll create them. The work you do here will influence how this entire category gets designed.

•

Fast-Track to Design Leadership: This is a founding-trajectory role and we’re hiring for someone who wants a long-term home, not a stepping stone. As the team scales, the natural path is IC → Lead → Head of Design. If you have leadership ambitions, you’ll have the runway to grow into them. If you’d rather stay deeply hands-on, the IC scope grows with the product.

•

Ambitious Challenge: We’re using generative AI (LLMs and agents) to solve one of the most pressing problems in cybersecurity — the gap between vulnerability findings and meaningful action. You’ll be designing at the cutting edge of this field.

•

Expert Team: Work alongside hands-on leaders with experience in Big Tech and Scale-ups. Our team has been part of the leadership teams behind multiple acquisitions and an IPO.

•

Impactful Work: Cybersecurity is a force for good. The experiences you design will directly affect how security teams protect organisations worldwide.

•

Build an AI-Native Company: We’re building a new company in the AI era with the opportunity to design everything from the ground up — including how the design function itself works. You’ll help pioneer AI-assisted design practices and set new standards.

You will be FORT’s first full-time designer, responsible for building the design platform from 0→1 across hardware interaction, operator-facing software, and AI-assisted workflows. This role spans all three product pillars: Control, Intelligence, and Ecosystem. You will not be decorating screens; you will define how people interact with our hardware, software, and the autonomous systems that run on both.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Build FORT’s design foundation from scratch: design system, interaction model, and component library across FORT Manager and future platform surfaces.
- Design the physical interaction layer of FORT hardware, how operators read device state, safety status, and control affordances through button layout, LED signaling, and tactile feedback.
- Define human-robot interaction (HRI) patterns: how operators monitor, trust, intervene in, and recover autonomous systems, across both hardware and software surfaces.
- Design AI-forward workflows: AI Assistant interface, fleet observability dashboards, anomaly surfacing, and operator guidance experiences. Use AI tools actively to prototype and iterate faster.
- Conduct field research with industrial operators and OEM engineers in real deployment environments; run usability testing and translate findings directly into design decisions.
- Map end-to-end platform journeys across all user types: floor operators, OEM integration engineers, fleet administrators, and safety stakeholders.
- Partner daily with Product, Firmware, Software, Hardware, and Operations; translate technical constraints into design decisions without sacrificing usability.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

- 5+ years of product or interaction design experience, including at least 2 years in hardware-software combined environments, robotics, IoT, industrial automation, automotive, or similar.
- Built a design system or component library from scratch, not inherited one.
- Physical interaction design experience: designed how a hardware product communicates state, intent, or safety status to a human.
- Field research experience: contextual inquiry, operator shadowing, or usability testing in real-world environments.
- Proficient in Figma or equivalent, Claude; prototypes complex, multi-step workflows at high fidelity.
- AI-first approach: uses AI tools to accelerate design, prototyping, and research synthesis as a standard workflow, not a novelty.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

- Experience in safety-critical or regulated product environments (human factors, IEC 62366, or equivalent).
- Background in human-robot interaction, autonomous systems, or physical AI platforms.
- Familiarity with front-end basics (HTML/CSS) for tighter design-engineering handoff.
